entries.what: Elliot logs Theo's overnight feeds in the spreadsheet, then does the morning feed and a contact nap at unit 209 while the Vinca school traffic hums outside.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet updated; Theo napped on him for 40 minutes.

entries.what: Hana and Elliot split the afternoon. He does laundry at the card-only room downstairs and orders groceries by app.
entries.outcome: Diapers and oat milk ordered for tomorrow.

entries.what: Takeout dinner, then the evening crying stretch with Theo, ending with Elliot humming the slowed-down ballpark tune.
entries.outcome: Theo calmed by 8 p.m.

entries.what: Elliot wakes for the 2 a.m. feed and logs it, then catches up on the log and starts a new tab for incidents.
entries.outcome: Log now has an incidents tab.

entries.what: Mid-morning stroller trip to the mailbox and a few puzzle pieces on the lighthouse jigsaw during the nap.
entries.outcome: Two pieces placed; nap lasted only 35 minutes.

entries.what: Evening baby laundry run at Marisol Gardens, then pho takeout from Phở Bến Thành with Hana.
entries.outcome: Clean onesies folded, dinner eaten warm for once.

entries.what: The first 100-degree day. Elliot asks the assistant for a heat-wave checklist with room temperatures and onesie layers per degree, and sets up fans in the nursery corner.
entries.outcome: Checklist taped to the fridge.

entries.what: Keeps blinds closed, gives Theo extra feeds and logs diaper counts to watch hydration.
entries.outcome: Diaper count normal.

entries.what: Evening fussing worsens in the heat; Hana and Elliot take turns walking the hallway.
entries.outcome: Theo asleep at 9 after a lukewarm bath.

entries.what: Elliot reports the leaking bathroom faucet in 209 to the Marisol Gardens office and gets a vague promise from Gloria.
entries.outcome: Ticket opened, no repair date.

entries.what: Heat wave day two. Takes Theo to the library cooling center for an hour of air conditioning, then home for a nap.
entries.outcome: Cooler hour, Theo slept in the stroller.

entries.what: Puts a damp towel under the bathroom sink drip and checks the monitor, which drops when the microwave runs.
entries.outcome: Reheated dinner by the stove instead.

entries.what: After a rough crying night heard through the shared wall, Elliot asks the assistant for wording for a sorry note and a pan dulce gift for unit 211.
entries.outcome: Note drafted; pan dulce planned for tomorrow.

entries.what: Midday heat; keeps Theo in a single layer with a fan and logs every nap, noting the longest was 50 minutes.
entries.outcome: Log updated.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry, then a quiet dinner with Hana on the couch.
entries.outcome: Laundry done before the 9 p.m. fussing.

entries.what: First Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier. Elliot buys real groceries and orders only diapers for delivery from now on.
entries.outcome: Switched from app delivery to a weekly market trip.

entries.what: Leaves a pan dulce bag and the sorry note at 211's door in the heat.
entries.outcome: No answer at the door.

entries.what: Afternoon heat wave finale; Elliot unpacks groceries, puts the jigsaw aside and naps beside Theo.
entries.outcome: Everyone got a nap.

entries.what: Elliot does the 2 a.m. feed and notes in the log that Theo woke again at 5 for Hana.
entries.outcome: Log current.

entries.what: Sunday morning eggs and oat milk, then a short stroller walk as the fog returns.
entries.outcome: Cooler air; Theo slept the whole walk.

entries.what: Looks over the week's log numbers and plans Monday groceries, bracing for Brenda's emails.
entries.outcome: Short plan for next week written.
